threat_event: A known vulnerability in an internet-facing SBC or edge router is exploited for initial access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 140 SBCs run releases past vendor support; 14-day patch target for known exploited vulnerabilities met 81% for network devices
existing_controls: Vendor advisories monitored; quarterly external scans
treatment_plan: Replace or isolate the 9 SBCs; authenticated scanning of all network devices; 14-day patch target tracked weekly

threat_event: Intruder uses shared local administrator accounts to reconfigure or wipe access-network elements, causing an outage that includes 911
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 38% of access elements and 22 SBCs in the acquired regions use shared local accounts; TACACS+ with MFA only on core routers there
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-C7 and SYS-C6 in the acquired regions; SYS-C5
treatment_plan: Named TACACS+ accounts with MFA on every element class; local accounts sealed for break-glass

threat_event: Intruder steals call detail records from the mediation collectors and CDR store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Collectors reachable from the acquired-region management plane; no object-level read logging on the CDR store
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; restricted rating interface
treatment_plan: Object-level read logging; collector isolation; exfiltration alerts on CDR volumes

threat_event: Affiliate operators view Carrier CPNI in trouble tickets through the legacy cross-tenant role
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy role held by about 410 Engineering and 60 Tower operators; no CPNI training for them
existing_controls: SIEM alerts on bulk ticket exports
treatment_plan: Remove the role by 2026-11-30; work package view for joint restoration

threat_event: Carrier CPNI is used by an affiliate for marketing without customer approval or a campaign record
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intercompany CPNI agreement; 2026 Engineering campaign used enterprise service data
existing_controls: Approval flags in the BSS for Carrier campaigns
treatment_plan: Intercompany CPNI agreement; affiliate campaigns routed through the Carrier campaign tool; campaign register
owner: Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance

threat_event: The AI chatbot discloses CPNI to someone other than the customer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Account recovery pilot accepted account number and SSN4 (disabled 2026-08-07); prompt injection tests incomplete
existing_controls: Account data only after sign-in; API allow-list
treatment_plan: Compliant recovery design with one-time codes to the number or email of record; red-team tests before each release

threat_event: Pretexters obtain call detail from outsourced agents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Outsourced agents 74% CPNI-trained; vendor supervisors can override the password prompt
treatment_plan: Remove override rights; complete training; monthly call sampling

threat_event: Network element configurations in the acquired regions cannot be restored after destruction
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Configuration backups on one server per acquired region; no offline copy
existing_controls: Nightly backups to the regional server
treatment_plan: Offline encrypted copies in a second region and the immutable vault; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts OSS/BSS cloud workloads and regional NOC servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and hub; on-premises NOC servers
existing_controls: Immutable backups; EDR; DR copies in provider B
treatment_plan: Offline configuration copies (TC-008); NOC server hardening; tabletop

threat_event: Management plane intrusion goes undetected in the acquired regions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Element syslog and AAA logs from the acquired regions are not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Onboard logs; login anomaly use cases

threat_event: An agent sells call detail or account data to a data broker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents can view call detail for any account in their queue
treatment_plan: Extend analytics to outsourced agents; quarterly review of top viewers

threat_event: A contact center vendor breach exposes call recordings and account data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One outsourced vendor contract lacks 24-hour incident notice terms
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 review of the CCaaS vendor
treatment_plan: Amend contract; annual on-site review of both vendors

threat_event: Lawful-intercept system in the acquired regions is reached through shared management segments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-C8 management path shares SYS-C5 segments in 2 regions
treatment_plan: Isolated management path and jump host for SYS-C8
owner: Carrier Vice President, Network Security and Lawful Intercept

threat_event: Law enforcement cannot reach the right senior officer, and the FCC finds stale SSI filings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 operating companies' SSI policies not refiled after the 2024 merger; appendix names a former employee
treatment_plan: Refile through the FCC electronic system; quarterly appendix check
owner: Carrier Vice President, Network Security and Lawful Intercept

threat_event: The CPNI law enforcement notice is late or customers are told before the 7-business-day hold ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix not exercised; state law clocks run in parallel
existing_controls: Reporting facility account; counsel on retainer
treatment_plan: P08 worked example and tabletop
owner: Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance

threat_event: Hurricane causes multi-day outages in Florida regions, including 911
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration of customers in coastal Florida
treatment_plan: Fuel contracts; joint plan with Engineering crews

threat_event: A containment action causes a 911 outage or lost alarms without the required notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IR playbooks do not require a service-impact check before isolating SBCs or the service assurance platform
treatment_plan: Service-impact gate in IR playbooks; NOC on the incident bridge

threat_event: Service assurance platform outage with a failed disaster recovery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Never failed over with all three tenants
treatment_plan: Three-tenant failover test

threat_event: The annual CPNI certification statement is inaccurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Statement for 2025 did not mention affiliate access or the chatbot pilot
treatment_plan: Evidence-based statement for the filing due 2027-03-01
owner: Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance

threat_event: Deposit decisions lack required adverse action notices or produce unfair outcomes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Online and chat orders do not send adverse action notices; outcomes not monitored by group
existing_controls: Notices sent for orders taken by agents
treatment_plan: Notices on every channel; quarterly outcome monitoring (P10)

threat_event: Account takeover in the acquired regions goes unnoticed because change notices are missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy billing portal sends no notice for address-of-record changes
treatment_plan: Add notices before migration

threat_event: Covered equipment is installed and the 1.50007 certification becomes inaccurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual screening with no record
treatment_plan: Automated screening (GR-07)

threat_event: Volumetric DDoS against the portal, API gateway, or DNS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public endpoints
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; scrubbing for customer traffic
treatment_plan: Keep provider protection and transit scrubbing contracts

threat_event: Toll fraud through compromised SBC trunks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fraud rules tuned for legacy regions only
treatment_plan: Extend fraud rules to all SBCs

threat_event: Static secrets for OSS integrations are stolen and reused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Service account secrets older than 1 year in 3 integrations
treatment_plan: Workload identity; 90-day rotation

threat_event: Lost technician tablet exposes cached work orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 9,000 tablets
existing_controls: Mobile device management with remote wipe and encryption
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Carrier security and compliance lead (encryption and remote wipe in place)

threat_event: Long CDR retention increases the volume exposed in a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 24 months online
treatment_plan: Review retention against billing dispute and legal needs; move older CDRs offline

threat_event: PSAP outage contacts in the acquired regions are out of date
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contacts last confirmed 2024
existing_controls: Contacts confirmed annually in legacy regions
treatment_plan: Confirm all contacts; annual calendar task

threat_event: Phished NOC staff credentials used to reach element managers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NOC staff use number-matching MFA, not phishing-resistant keys
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant keys for NOC staff

threat_event: Bill print vendor exposes bill images with toll call detail
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds bill images 90 days
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Carrier security and compliance lead
